name: NatWest Group plc
research_rationale: Q3 RoTE and income outlook still align with cheapness/dividend screens; absent new data, elevated Q3 impairments and bank surcharge/tax keep the buy case tempered rather than strengthened.

weekly_updates.summary:
30 Oct Q3 2026 IMS: attributable profit £1.5bn, RoTE 21.6%, total income +9.6% YTD; H1 income outlook reaffirmed, RWA ~£210bn at 1 Jan 2027 (Basel 3.1).  
Q3 impairment £277m (~2× prior-year quarter) and higher YTD tax (bank surcharge) drove a share fall despite operational strength.  
Quant screen still buy (4w, stable); timing accumulate, RSI ~29.

No news or new filings since the 30 Oct Q3 IMS refresh; thesis and risks unchanged.  
Quant screen remains buy (5w, stable); timing still accumulate, RSI ~29.  
No material change.
